summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from the official oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style string-array-with-rotation bundle (rotate function, large mixed hex/string constant array, hex-named identifiers) whose behavior is not observable through normal Node-based inspection. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute a bundled opaque script at install time is unrelated to the package's declared purpose of shipping design tokens, and the obfuscation hides what the payload does once it runs. The package name resembles a ServiceTitan-scoped internal utility but the install-time behavior does not match that stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
